name: doc-sweep
description: Update CLAUDE.md + JSDoc when convention emerges in the sprint. Triggered by significant code changes that introduce new patterns. Paired with daemon's `document` worker (paused during sprint, so doc-sweep runs in its place).
trigger_threshold: 5+ commits touching the same module/area within 2h

doc_targets.CLAUDE.md: convention updates only (not full feature docs)
doc_targets.JSDoc: new exported functions in packages/* and apps/lambdas/*/src/routes/*
doc_targets.README.md: rare — only if module entry-point changes

forbidden: modifying source code logic (only doc comments + markdown)

scope_rules.JSDoc: add docs to NEW exported functions; do NOT rewrite existing docs unless wrong
scope_rules.CLAUDE.md: propose under '## Active sprint' Convention learnings — never auto-merge to main rules
scope_rules.format: match existing voice — terse, what+why, no obvious info

notes: doc-sweep proposes changes but does NOT auto-commit. Surfaces a diff to the user; they approve, then the commit lands. Pairs with the `documentation-sync` skill if installed.
